learning_outcomes.text: Be able to design power electronics circuits
Be able to select appropriate electronic components for the design
Be able to implement designed power electronics circuits

syllabus_topics: Introduction to power electronics circuit design and basic standards
Determination of design criteria for AC-DC converters
Analysis and selection of circuit elements used in AC-DC converters
Simulation of the designed circuit and verification of the design
Determination of design criteria for AC-AC converters
Analysis and selection of circuit elements used in AC-AC converters
Simulation of the designed circuit and verification of the design
Determination of design criteria for DC-DC converters
Analysis and selection of circuit elements used in DC-DC converters
Simulation of the designed circuit and verification of the design
Determination of design criteria for DC-AC converters
Analysis and selection of circuit elements used in DC-AC converters
Simulation of the designed circuit and verification of the design
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decisions in the academic calendar.
bibliography: Daniel W. Hart , “Power Electronics”, McGraw Hill
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
